faq.q: How does Titanium ROV Manipulator Knuckle perform in deep-sea pressure environments?
faq.a: Titanium ROV Manipulator Knuckle fabricated from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V is suitable for full-ocean-depth operation (11,000 m, 110 MPa external pressure). With 830 MPa yield strength and spherical/cylindrical collapse pressure margins >2× for rov scientific payload, titanium's strength-to-weight ratio provides the deepest diving capability per unit mass of any structural metal. Buckling analysis per API 1111 is provided for each design.
